items.stem: In the 'Read and Complete' (C-test) task, how should a candidate restore the partially deleted words?

options.text: Use context and English spelling patterns to complete each word
options.rationale: Correct: candidates infer each word from sentence context and known spelling patterns.

options.text: Leave them blank to avoid penalties
options.rationale: Leaving words blank forfeits the points available for correct completion.

options.text: Replace them with words from another language
options.rationale: Responses must be in English and fit the passage.

options.text: Rewrite the whole passage in their own words
options.rationale: The task is to complete the given words, not rewrite the passage.

items.explanation: Correct: candidates infer each word from sentence context and known spelling patterns.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: The Duolingo English Test is adaptive. What does that mean for the items a candidate receives?

options.text: Item difficulty adjusts based on the candidate's responses
options.rationale: Correct: an adaptive test changes item difficulty according to performance.

options.text: Every candidate receives exactly the same fixed items
options.rationale: Adaptive testing does not give all candidates identical fixed items.

options.text: Items are chosen only by the candidate's age
options.rationale: Adaptivity is based on responses, not age.

options.text: The test shows all items at once to choose from
options.rationale: Items are presented in sequence, adapting to responses.

items.explanation: Correct: an adaptive test changes item difficulty according to performance.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Select TWO task types that assess speaking in the Duolingo English Test.

options.rationale: Correct: speak-about-the-photo is a speaking task.
Correct: reading a sentence aloud is a speaking task.
Read-and-select assesses reading/vocabulary recognition, not speaking.
Listen-and-type assesses listening and writing, not speaking.
Read-and-complete is a reading/writing task, not speaking.
